title: Have you seen Biscuit?
subtitle: Golden retriever · lost near Freedom Park on Oct 5
details_html:
• Male, 3 years old, 65 lbs, honey-colored coat
  • Wearing a blue collar with a brass tag
  • Very friendly — answers to “Biscuit”
  • Last seen Monday Oct 5, ~6 PM, by the duck pond
emergency_html:
Do not chase

He's scared and fast. If you see him, crouch down, stay still, and call us right away.
contact_html: Call or text any time, day or night: (704) 555-0142
venue_text: Freedom Park duck pond, Charlotte NC
